paragraphs: Govstack sells website and online service software to public sector organizations, giving them tools to engage and connect with their communities. The audience is city staff along with the residents, visitors and business owners who need access to city services and information.

The content management system is built for public sector organizations that require full control of their site content. Staff publish without developers, because no coding or technical skills are required to build a site. The forms product carries municipal services online, with customizable workflows for applications and permits and data collected and analyzed in real time. A citizen portal gives residents one login to find information, pay for taxes and licenses, and get real-time updates on what is happening across the city. An events product sends reminders, takes registrations, processes payments and lets residents add events to their personal calendar.

Govstack states that its forms are built to comply with accessibility and WCAG 2.0 AA standards. Buyers can also draw on a library of forms developed and used by GHD Digital public sector clients. The company says it is an active member of several public sector focused associations across North America.

quote.text: Empower your staff, residents, visitors and business owners with easy access to your city services and information.
